spec.assertion: Self-only atkPct 4.22, maxStacks 30, and the FIRST stack apply must come after the first self 37.8 crit apply (her own burst opening the window); plus at least one expiresFrame gap > 600 frames proving the pool lapses between windows. RED under the nearest-wrong ungated hitCount model, where an MG clears 15 rounds inside the first second and stacks are applied continuously all fight (first stack precedes any burst; no 10 s hole ever opens). Also RED if authored as one pre-summed 126.6 buff (no stacked applies).

it.skip — no HP pool and no recovery-sharing primitive. Flagged as an adjudication fork, not a silent skip: the fixture's B2 support consumes recovery triggers, so encoding the share as heals to all allies would move a teammate's damage materially.

A critRatePct (NOT critRateNormalPct) apply of 37.8 targeting rem herself, with zero critRateNormalPct applies from rem and zero 37.8 crit applies leaking to teammates. casterAtkPct applies from rem reach exactly one target slug — the Rocket-Launcher ally — and never liter (SMG), helm (SR) or rem (MG); the emitted value is FLAT-resolved (> 1000, not 50.78). Counterfactual: stripping the effect lowers the RL ally's total while liter/helm/rem stay byte-identical. RED under a {kind:'allies'} target (leaks onto the SMG/SR allies), under self-targeting, and under a raw-percentage emission.

maxAmmoFlat value 5 from rem on the SAME target set as the ATK buff, with zero maxAmmoPct applies from rem; the counterfactual strip changes the RL ally's total, proving the weapon-state modifier is live damage (it gates shots fired). RED if authored as maxAmmoPct 5 (a percent of an RL magazine is a fraction of a round, essentially inert) or dropped as 'defensive'.

spec.kitLine: shared trigger across all 3 burst lines
spec.assertion: Count of self-crit applies === count of RL ATK applies === count of RL ammo applies (with exactly one RL ally). RED if any line is keyed to fullBurstEnter instead of her own burst cast — rem is Burst II and shares stage 2 with the fixture's B2 support, so a full-burst-enter keying over-fires on rotations she does not cast.

fixtures: controlComp('rem', true) → liter (B1) / crown (B2, Rocket Launcher) / rem / helm (B3, SR/Water), deterministic, no seed; 3 hoisted runs (baseline + two withPatchedOverride counterfactuals stripping the burst casterAtkPct and the burst max-ammo effects). The fixed B3 slot is REQUIRED, not optional: rem is Burst II and a chain cannot complete without a B3 — with helm dropped the comp makes ZERO full bursts and every burst-keyed line goes vacuous. The RL-scoped burst buffs need a Rocket-Launcher ally, which the fixture's B2 support supplies, while liter (SMG) and helm (SR) serve as the weapon-scope negative controls. KNOWN FIXTURE RISK, asserted rather than assumed: rem shares burst stage 2 with the fixed B2 support, so she may cast rarely or never; the first test hard-asserts she casts at least once (via her self-crit marker), and a failure there means re-fixture with a non-B2 support, not an override defect. Her own burst cast is identified by that self-targeted 37.8 crit apply rather than by burstCast event fields, and her unit index is read off that same event — so no assumption is made about slot ordering or burstCast's caster field. No frame field is used anywhere; window structure is read from expiresFrame spacing and from event ordering within the log.

skill2 a (recovers a % of attack damage as HP continuously, self) — it.skip: lifesteal has no primitive; no on-recovery consumer on rem herself.
skill2 b (shares recovery with self + 2 highest-final-ATK Rocket-Launcher allies) — it.skip: target set inexpressible (no weapon-filtered top-N-by-final-ATK selector) AND no share primitive.

ENCODING-OPEN, not asserted: 'Demon's Breath' is a SELF status, but the engine's only status-window primitive (targetStatus / requiresTargetStatus) is enemy-scoped and the validator requires the carrying block to be authored with target `enemy`. The tests therefore assert the observable window behaviour (stacks start at her own burst, lapse between windows) and deliberately do not assert any particular encoding.

⚑ MG cadence tuple (pulls/s, wind-up) is datamine-unreliable and outside the kit text — no assertion depends on an absolute stack count per window, only on stacking being real (peak stacks ≥ 2, ≤ 30).
